question: Should Rhamnus purshianus be recommended for: short-term use in occasional constipation?

records.notes: EU herbal monograph on cascara (Rhamnus purshianus) bark grants well-established-use status for short-term use in occasional constipation, standardised to hydroxyanthracene derivatives per Ph. Eur. Cascara 01/2005:0105.
records.source_title: Community/Union herbal monograph on Rhamnus purshianus D.C., cortex
